entities.summary: The Academy of the Arabic Language in Cairo is a language academy for Arabic created in Cairo, Egypt in 1932 by Fuad I of Egypt. It publishes Al-Mu'jam al-Kabir and Al-Mu'jam al-Wasīt , two of the most important dictionaries of the Arabic language.
